03 / WORKFLOW

From medical data
to a buildable design.

1
ANALYZE

Patient analysis

Review imaging data and define the design objective around the reconstructive or aesthetic need.

2
SIMULATE

Surgical simulation

Analyze orthognathic candidates in ProPlan and simulate surgical movements before treatment.

3
DESIGN

Patient-specific design

Model in FreeForm, assess fit, and design intermediate and final surgical splints.

4
MANUFACTURE

Production preparation

Prepare accurate physical outputs with experience across DLP, filament and PEEK printing.

04 / ABOUT

Design at the edge of
medicine and engineering.

In maxillofacial design, every millimetre can influence treatment, facial symmetry and the patient experience.

At Farin Roshaan, I work across aesthetic and therapeutic implants, subperiosteal frameworks, surgical guides and orthognathic splints. Designing for more than 400 patient cases has shaped an approach grounded in digital precision, manufacturability and clinical context.
